FINAL SESSION LOG — Gerrit Verified CI latency investigation and remediation (2026-08-13)

Outcome
- Completed the rebar-debug RCA on cryptic-damp-panda. The deterministic regression was macOS pytest growth: default + integration increased by 870.72s (14m31s) from the Aug 1 comparison. Queueing/contention adds a separate tail.
- Mutation testing was exonerated as the direct cause: only 5/62 sampled successful runs selected shards; 57 skipped; direct critical-path addition was 0m; active-mutation runs averaged 33.0m versus 36.5m when skipped. Mutation can add aggregate Ubuntu usage when selected but does not explain the regression.
- Individual long poles were measured, including the 120s Jira wait, 15–25s retry sleeps, repeated AST scans, 321.6–495.6 aggregate wiki corpus work, the 77–90s N=3000 importer, repeated package builds, and 9–15s real socket/process sentinels.

Landed and closed
- albinic-kyanite-goldeneye: logical time for Jira readiness, commit 6f37d9495b.
- coed-defectible-muskox: injected/late-bound retry sleepers, commit 3182cd470a.
- analogical-dashing-fennecfox: reuse immutable AST analysis, commit 012854fb86.
- harmless-wavy-osprey: share wiki render artifact across xdist workers, commit 48a3ba0b8a.
- curricular-mean-cuckoo: N=3000 importer 77.231s -> 17.040s while preserving 6,000 events and exactly 24 commits; Gerrit 1730, merged 35825701c8.
- despotic-dorsal-greatdane: session/per-worker immutable build artifacts; 35.93s baseline -> 12.25s original repair measurement and 18.16s on latest-main focused rerun; Gerrit 1747, merged c1b6244b74.
- classless-dainty-lamprey: shortened test-only real socket/process trigger windows with production defaults unchanged; focused nodes green in 3.88s and both files 20 passed in 10.53s on final rebase; Gerrit 1748, merged a79ed876b0.
- future-fibroid-hammerkop, the linked xdist order-dependence bug, is also closed and completion-attested.
- rancid-aerophobic-skylark repaired the inherited 808-line module-size failure that initially blocked change 1730; Gerrit 1732 merged ea6ee67e6a.
- albinic-agrologic-dolphin fixed the macOS wiki-render xdist worker crash; Gerrit 1745 merged 0ed803029af.

Coverage and OSS decisions
- All seven latency remediations matched maintained OSS practice (Kubernetes/Tenacity/urllib3 logical time; pytest-xdist artifact sharing; Pylint/Astroid AST reuse; Setuptools/PyPA Build artifact reuse; CPython/urllib3 short injected windows; Git bulk-path amortization) and were implemented under the operator approval.
- No test assertion, mutation coverage, OS/Python matrix cell, real build/socket/process boundary, worker, or runner was removed. Extra sharding and xdist -n4 remain rejected because they increase runner usage/contention.

CI observations
- Change 1730 patchset 3 spent 14m41s waiting for macOS after eligibility, then passed all cells; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments.
- Gerrit 1747 had no macOS queue and completed in 34m12s; Linux cells took 13m22s–14m16s while macOS took 33m10s.
- Gerrit 1748 completed in 27m46s with macOS at 26m43s. The observed 6m26s improvement versus 1747 includes suite/runtime variability and is not attributed solely to the directly removed waits.

Final tracker state
- The RCA, all eight linked discovered work tickets, the change-1730 module-size repair, and the wiki xdist-flake repair are closed, have zero unchecked acceptance criteria, and carry completion-verifier attestations. No audited session ticket remains in_progress.
- dotted-uncheery-dunnart remains intentionally open and unclaimed for the residual Verified-lane contention problem. Its two remaining criteria are to quantify per-run job-slot/queue cost and choose a runner-usage-neutral remediation or explicitly accept the contention.
- Existing open session-log records are durable logs, not unfinished implementation tickets.

Operational note
- Several orphaned background compactor processes from other temporary worktrees repeatedly held the shared tracker lock for 4–12+ minutes. Each exact isolated process group was inspected, terminated gracefully with TERM only after proving it orphaned, and the transactional ticket writes then completed. No tracker data was lost.
- All three implementation worktrees created for the final changes were clean and retired after merge/closure. The primary checkout was not reset or modified.

compiled_state.title: Gerrit Verified CI latency RCA and seven coverage-neutral remediations
